summary: Comprehensive review and synthesis of the 41 prospective papers from `/home/kim/Projects/SAO/papers/Prospective Unchecked/`, covering modular norm-constrained optimization (SCION, Mousse, Newton-Muon, KL-Shampoo, SoftMuon, HyperTransfer), DiT-specific optimizations (Periodic Row-wise Muon, SAMuon spectral allocation, RODE radial-angular decoupling), native low-rank adapter descent (LoRA-TSD, sMuon, AnLR-LoRA), overtraining-aware schedules (Everett & Qiu), and DiT / flow matching architectures (FDFO, SegTune, DiffRhythm 2).
